title: dioscorea preussii subsp. hylophila
intro: Dioscorea preussii subsp. hylophila, commonly known as the West African yam, is a plant species belonging to the Dioscoreaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Dioscorea preussii subsp. hylophila include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a saponin compound with potential therapeutic effects.
